description: How stable the app's released versions are, from the stores themselves. Read-only. Google Play: the user-perceived crash and ANR rates over 28 days, overall and per version code, against Play's bad-behavior thresholds (1.09% crashes, 0.47% ANRs), and the crashes and ANRs people hit most. App Store: Apple's API has no crash rates, so it gives what Apple offers: Xcode's performance metrics per version (launch time, hangs, memory, disk writes…) with Apple's regressions, and each build's diagnostics (hangs, disk writes, launches). Give releaseId (or platform and version) to check one release before promoting it or widening its rollout; leave them out for the whole app.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask the stores again instead of the copy from the last half hour.

releaseId.description: The release ID that ploa_release_start returned.

version.description: Android: the version code. iOS: the build number.

versionName.description: iOS: the version the build belongs to, like 1.2.0.

name: ploa_quality
title: How stable a release is
